voice_timing.text: High above the metropolis, our camera pans 360 degrees around player and drone, taking in the sweeping urban ring while maintaining a comfortable, rock-solid field of view.

As we strafe sideways, watch the drone roll smoothly into the bank, counter-tilt to arrest momentum, and return to an effortless hover. Pauses between inputs make every aerodynamic response clear and satisfying.
This behavior turns the drone into a loyal flying sidekick. Exploring a limitless voxel metropolis is infinitely more exciting when you have an intelligent companion tracking your every move!
